verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਘਰੀ ਟੇਰਿ ਘਰੀਆਰ ਸੁਨਾਇ ਸੰਦੇਸੋ ਪਹਿਰ ਪਹਿਰ ਪੁਨਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gharee gharee Ter ghareeaar sunai sa(n)dheso pahir pahir pun pun samajhai hai ||

en.bdb: The clock is repeatedly and loudly conveying a message after every watch and every pehar (a quarter of a day/night, that the time is rolling by).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਬੂਡਤ ਹੈ  ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਪਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jaise jal bhar bhar belee booddat hai  pooran hui paapan kee naaveh harai hai ||

en.bdb: As the water clock sinks repeatedly, 0 human being! you are also sinking your boat of life with ever increasing sins.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਸੋਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਰੂਆ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਹਾਰੇ ਚਾਰੋ ਜਾਮ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chahoo(n) or sor kai paaharooaa pukaar haare chaaro jaam sovate achet na lajai hai ||

en.bdb: The True Guru is warning you repeatedly from all directions; O unattentive and senseless person! the four pehars of your night-like life are being spent sleeping in ignorance. You seemed to have no shame of your concern.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਮਚੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਹੀ ਉਘਾਰ ਆਂਖੈਂ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛਤਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੭॥
verses.translit_en: tamachur sabadh sunat hee ughaar aa(n)khai(n) bin piray prem ras paachhai pachhatai hai ||657||

en.bdb: O living being! be aware, open your eyes with the crowing of the cock, be attentive after attending to your body needs, taste the elixir of love with the Lord. Without relishing the Naam Amrit of beloved Lord's name, one would feel repentant ultimately.  (657)
